state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** `nvs-types` closed `a-tainted-url-diagnostic-does-not-name-allowurl`. A `tainted` URL at a parameter that admits `Core\Http\Target` now carries a help naming `Core\Http::allowUrl` (`check_url_arg` in `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/args.rs`). The seven request members `get` to `head` and `request` are `Grammar::Uri` rows in `crates/nvs-types/src/intrinsics.rs`, so a malformed literal URL there is `E0769`. The gap `a-literal-url-at-the-http-client-is-not-read-while-checking` is narrowed to `stream`, `openSocket` and `allowUrl`.

The only `nvs-runtime` gap left is `enum-case-that-reached-a-mixed`. It needs an ADR beyond Stage 5's one slot, so it waits for the user. It goes to `BLOCKED` only once it is the last goal-owned gap in the tree.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes. A person has to push.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest, in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-syntax`, `nvs-types`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.

Add a line each to `tests/conformance/reject/a-malformed-literal-url-at-the-http-client-is-a-compile-error.nvst` and delete the gap.
